lines.para: German military intelligence. Since 1935 it has been run by Admiral Wilhelm Canaris, a secretive man whose true allegiance would long be debated. Its agents recruit in business circles, ports, universities and high society all over Europe.
Heir to a shipping family, a brilliant student, ironic and fragile. Popov’s friend since Freiburg. He joins the Abwehr at the start of the war, partly, it is said, to avoid the front.
In February 1945, the Gestapo takes him from the camp where he was held. He is never seen again, almost certainly murdered.
In 2012, historian Ben Macintyre called him a hero. His silence protected Popov and thousands of Allied soldiers.
